evidence.detail: Exact v308 rs/gui/b/f stores exactly two final ints, has constructors (itemId, quantity) and (itemId) with the latter defaulting quantity to 1, and exposes one getter for each value.
R143 LoadoutDefinition stores this type both in its 28-slot inventory array and in its LoadoutEquipmentSlot map; clone, persistence and spawn workflows all read/write the same entry type.
R143 LoadoutPersistence serializes and deserializes both integer fields for every equipment/inventory entry, preserving item id and quantity independently.
The reviewed loadout spawn path reads the first field as item id and the second as quantity when generating the in-game loadout item/equipment state.

R260 LoadoutItemImageCache accepts this exact type, keys its cache from the entry item id, and the rs/gui/b/f image helper resolves an item image from that same first field; R260 already refers to the record as LoadoutItemEntry in its exact evidence.

candidates.note: Later R143/R260/R276-R279 exact loadout evidence resolves the noun that was intentionally withheld in the earlier frontier note. This is a descriptive exact-v308 name, not a claim of original stripped source text.
